case_name: Battleship clip 1: the MCP on the bridge sequence, text only and with the premade bridge still
title: Resolute bridge, clip 1
must_haves: The three crew match their descriptions: Vale (cropped dark hair, navy double-breasted coat, brass binoculars), the lookout (curly black hair, red headset), the helmsman (blond braid, rolled sleeves), and stay the same people throughout.
The bridge is a narrow steel bridge with slanted front windows, a chart table and cool overhead lamps, the same room throughout.
The actions happen in order: the lookout points at the horizon, Vale raises binoculars, then lowers them and gives the command to fire.
A small tactical screen with amber graphics is visible on the bridge.
Cold late-afternoon light through the windows; about 15 seconds, widescreen 16:9; no extra people, no duplicated crew.

turns.text: Clip 1 of a battleship film, 15 s widescreen: on the bridge of the Resolute, the lookout spots an enemy cruiser on the horizon and points it out, Captain Vale raises her binoculars to confirm, the small tactical screen tracks the vessel, and Vale lowers the binoculars and gives a clear command to fire. Captain Vale: cropped dark hair, navy double-breasted coat, brass binoculars. Lookout: young man, curly black hair, navy sailor shirt, red headset. Helmsman: woman, blond braid, navy sailor shirt, rolled sleeves. Bridge: narrow steel, slanted front windows, central chart table, cool overhead lamps.
